segments.name: Connected Operations
segments.description: Provides an open Connected Operations Platform connecting people, assets and systems, plus IoT devices and applications, to organizations with physical operations.
segments.evidence: Our Data Platform powers our Applications, which include AI Video-Based Safety, Telematics, Asset Tracking, Routing, Commercial Navigation, Maintenance, Connected Training, Connected Forms, and Site Visibility.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees for access to the Connected Operations Platform, generally priced per asset and per application.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer access to our Connected Operations Platform on a subscription basis and generally price each subscription on a per asset, per application basis.
